ABOUT THE JOB

We are looking for a highly organised and motivated Project/ Program Manager Intern to join our dynamic team. As an intern, you'll assist in managing our On Prem/Saas  product delivery. You will assist in the planning, managing, and execution of several technical programs and initiatives each year for our Engineering Organisation across our Product portfolio. You will get an first-hand experience in driving the improvement of our processes throughout the development, validation and deployment lifecycle. You will be collaborating with stakeholders and understanding the components of delivering large features/ initiatives and their associated technical complexities. This role will provide you the opportunity to learn how to navigate complex situations while evaluating risks and aligning with business priorities. You will learn to manage tasks while working in a fast-paced environment and developing your technical expertise. Your responsibilities will include assisting in driving metrics improvement, learning to communicate the current status, and helping in delivering features to market.

 

Responsibilities include:

Planning & Execution: 

- Assist in defining program scope, goals, milestones & success metrics

- Develop & maintain project plans, schedules & documentation

- Track project progress and communicate updates to stakeholders

- Create dashboards or reports to track progress, KPIs

 

Coordination and Communication:

- Collaborate with Engineering and Product Leadership and functions such as Engineering, Product Management, Customer Support etc. to prioritize, plan, and deliver new features and products to the market. 

- Assisting in the communication of schedules, status, and issues to stakeholders.

- Assist in running effective and efficient meetings that accomplish goals in a timely manner. 

Risk Management:

- Identifying potential risks and assisting in the development of mitigation plans.

- Collaborating with development teams to aid in addressing and resolving issues that may impact timelines.

Continuous Improvement:

- Recommending tools and methodologies to enhance efficiency and automation

- Document lessons learned and best practices for future projects

Mandatory Skills & Qualifications: 

  • Pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems or a related field. 
  • Strong organizational and analytical skills
  • Basic understanding of Software development lifecycle(SDLC) and agile methodologies
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to learn fast and work collaboratively in a fast-paced team environment

Preferred/Nice-to-have skills

  • Exposure to Cloud Platforms - AWS/Azure/GCP
  • Exposure to Storage domain
  • Exposure to Enterprise product development

Minimum eligibility criteria
- CGPA 8 and above
- 2027 graduates of Circuital branches only
- Available from January 2027 to May 2027 in Bangalore for the onsite internship (No remote options)

Join Us in Securing and Accelerating the World's AI Transformation

Rubrik (RBRK), the Security and AI Operations Company, leads at the intersection of data protection, cyber resilience, and enterprise AI acceleration. Rubrik Security Cloud delivers complete cyber resilience by securing, monitoring, and recovering data, identities, and workloads across clouds. Rubrik Agent Cloud accelerates trusted AI agent deployments at scale by monitoring and auditing agentic actions, enforcing real-time guardrails, fine-tuning for accuracy and undoing agentic mistakes.

Inclusion @ Rubrik

At Rubrik, we are dedicated to fostering a culture where people from all backgrounds are valued, feel they belong, and believe they can succeed. Our commitment to inclusion is at the heart of our mission to secure the world’s data.

Our goal is to hire and promote the best talent, regardless of background. We continually review our hiring practices to ensure fairness and strive to create an environment where every employee has equal access to opportunities for growth and excellence. We believe in empowering everyone to bring their authentic selves to work and achieve their fullest potential.

Our inclusion strategy focuses on three core areas of our business and culture:

  • Our Company: We are committed to building a merit-based organization that offers equal access to growth and success for all employees globally. Your potential is limitless here.

  • Our Culture: We strive to create an inclusive atmosphere where individuals from all backgrounds feel a strong sense of belonging, can thrive, and do their best work. Your contributions help us innovate and break boundaries.

  • Our Communities: We are dedicated to expanding our engagement with the communities we operate in, creating opportunities for underrepresented talent and driving greater innovation for our clients. Your impact extends beyond Rubrik, contributing to safer and stronger communities.

494ffde117536b08.description:
Our mission is to automate coding. The first step in our journey is to build the best tool for professional programmers, using a combination of inventive research, design, and engineering. Our organization is very flat, and our team is small and talent dense. We particularly like people who are truth-seeking, passionate, and creative. We enjoy spirited debate, crazy ideas, and shipping code.
About the Role

We're hiring Field Engineers to partner with prospective and strategic customers across Public Sector. You'll be the technical face of SpaceXAI for the federal civilian and defense agencies modernizing how software gets written for the mission: helping developers, engineering leaders, and program teams evaluate Cursor, running proofs of concept, and making sure they see the full value of agentic coding in their real workflows.
You'll work hand-in-hand with Sales, Product, and Engineering as a deal partner, not a demo resource. You'll scope solutions, demonstrate capabilities, and act as a trusted advisor across the stakeholders that matter in PubSec: engineering leaders, architects, developers, security, procurement, and program leads. This is a highly customer-facing role where deep technical fluency, commercial instinct, and clear communication drive adoption and influence product direction.

What you'll do
• 
Partner with AEs to own technical discovery, demos, POCs, and technical validation for new deals and expansion
• 
Build trusted relationships across engineering, security, product and IT stakeholders
• 
Go deep in mission-critical and high-security environments: developer workflows, AI tooling, complex / constrained setups
• 
Help customers connect Cursor to outcomes that matter: developer productivity, secure software delivery, and mission velocity
• 
Deliver technical presentations, whiteboards, and workshops for technical and executive audiences
• 
Act as the customer's technical advocate internally with Product and Engineering
• 
Partner with post-sales to hand off cleanly and set up onboarding for success
You may be a fit if
• 
You have strong communication skills and executive presence, equally comfortable developing alongside engineers or presenting to CTOs, CISOs, and program leaders
• 
You understand the SDLC and can connect technical detail to mission and operational impact
• 
You have hands-on technical fluency (not full-time eng): workflows, AI tooling, complex / constrained environments
• 
You have deal-partner strategic instincts: co-own with AEs and navigate complex, multi-threaded stakeholder maps
• 
You have experience in Field Engineering, Solutions Architecture, Pre-Sales, or Consulting, ideally in federal, defense, or highly regulated tech
• 
You're excited by Public Sector and comfortable learning agency buying motions, security expectations, and partner ecosystems fast
• 
You hold or can obtain a federal security clearance (active clearance is a plus)
